pkgmetadata.longdescription: Fluxion is a security auditing social-engineering tool that attempts to recover WPA/WPA2 keys by attacking the environment around the target rather than the password itself: it spawns an evil-twin access point and either captures the handshake or presents a captive portal to harvest credentials. All dependencies are provided by portage; the upstream tool's built-in installer, remote self-updater and service mutation are disabled by patches per Gentoo packaging guidelines.
